item.title: Colorful terminals with Oh My Posh and Windows Terminal
item.description: Oh My Posh is a tool that not only enhance the appearance of your shell, but also offers useful integrations that makes the use more intuitive and helps us be more productive. I use it in WSL and in my home server and customized it to easily identify what shell I’m in:
